seo_title: Square D HOM230CP Homeline 30 Amp 2-Pole 120/240V Plug-On Miniature Circuit Breaker
short_description: Square D Homeline HOM230CP 30A 2-pole miniature circuit breaker, 120/240 VAC, 10 kA interrupt rating, plug-on mounting. UL Listed.
long_description:
The Square D Homeline HOM230CP is a 30 amp, 2-pole miniature circuit breaker rated for 120/240 VAC with a 10 kA short-circuit interrupt rating. Its thermal-magnetic trip unit provides reliable overload and short-circuit protection, and the plug-on design installs quickly in Homeline load centers.

Built on the proven HOM frame with 8-14 AWG terminal capacity, this breaker is UL Listed and CSA certified for residential and light commercial applications. A dependable choice for HVAC circuits, water heaters, and other 240V loads.
